issuer: the Secretaría de Movilidad (SEMOVI) of the State of Oaxaca
note: Read 2026-10-30 on the Congress of Oaxaca's site (its list of state legislation, legislacion_estatal.html, linking each law's consolidated PDF; the Congress reset the connection in wave 12 and answered today). The Ley de Movilidad para el Estado de Oaxaca (Decreto 634; last reform Decreto 1268, P.O. Extra 10 February 2026): the Secretaría is the Secretaría de Movilidad (art. 3 LIV); its licences are of the types the Reglamento sets (art. 172); they last two, three or five years, renewed for the same terms at the holder's request, and types A and B may be issued permanently on payment (art. 173), so the holder chooses the term and the file holds the four as terms. Art. 170: the Secretaría may give persons over sixteen and under eighteen permits to drive private vehicles in types A and B only; the licence's age is read from that, 18 (a reading, as Quintana Roo's, Guanajuato's and Yucatán's were: neither this law nor the Ley de Tránsito y Vialidad (reform of 3 January 2026, read: it defines the licence as the Secretaría de Movilidad's document and sets no age) states the licence's own age; the Reglamento, which sets the types, wasn't reached: SEMOVI's copy was behind a WAF in wave 12). The fee: the Ley Estatal de Derechos del Estado de Oaxaca (Decreto 779; last reform Decreto 1687, P.O. Extra 3 September 2026), art. 30 Bis I b), the first issue of the automovilista (tipo B) licence: 11.00 UMA for 5 years, 8.00 for 3, 6.00 for 2, 25.00 permanent (the renewal, II b), is the same for the terms of years). The UMA is Mexico's, held by the units engine. Type B is read as the private car's licence from the fee table's 'Automovilista, Tipo "B"' (type A being the motorcyclist's, C to E the public, freight and emergency operators').

sources.title: Ley de Movilidad para el Estado de Oaxaca (Congreso del Estado de Oaxaca, consolidated to Decreto 1268, P.O. Extra 10 February 2026)
sources.said: Último Decreto de Reforma: Decreto Número 1268 ... LIV. SECRETARÍA: Secretaría de Movilidad; ... Para el caso de las personas menores de dieciocho y mayores de dieciséis años, la Secretaría podrá otorgar permisos para conducir vehículos motorizados de uso privado, solo en las modalidades “A” y “B”. ... Artículo 172. Las licencias de conducir expedidas por la Secretaría serán de los tipos que se establezcan en el Reglamento de la presente Ley. ... Artículo 173. Las licencias de conducir tendrán una vigencia de dos, tres y cinco años ... En el caso de las licencias tipo “A” y “B”, se podrá expedir vigencia permanente, previo pago de derechos.
